terra.problem: The passage does not say Egypt was behind Moses as he faced the land, or why anyone climbs Pisgah.
The final sentence comments on how the card flipped a detail, rather than explaining the passage.
The passage does not say there was no crowd or that there were no helpers at the burial.
The passage does not say Eleazar was absent from the burial or mention a shovel.
The shovel line makes a joke about the LORD's action in burying Moses.
The passage says no one knew the grave's location; it does not say the LORD actively kept it secret.
The cookie comparison makes the LORD's burial of Moses part of the joke.
Moses' eyes were not weak, but the passage does not say he never squinted at anything.
The claim that seven days appears elsewhere in Scripture needs a reference outside this passage.
The passage says Moses went up the mountain, but it does not say Joshua did not climb it.
The passage says the Israelites obeyed Joshua, but does not say there was no fuss.
The passage does not identify this as Joshua's first day leading.
Moses not crossing into the land does not establish that he failed to see a promise come true. The land was promised to the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
The line about the card not tricking the baker jokes about the question itself.
